nodes.label: graphify Post-Commit Hook
nodes.rationale: Triggers once per commit instead of running a background watcher and works with any editor; only re-runs AST extraction on changed code files (no LLM cost), and leaves doc/image changes for a manual --update since those need semantic re-extraction.

nodes.label: graphify Native CLAUDE.md Integration
nodes.rationale: `graphify claude install` writes a persistent ## graphify section into the project's CLAUDE.md so Claude Code checks the graph before answering codebase questions and rebuilds it after code changes, without a manual /graphify invocation each session.
